explanations.48: The asterisk means children is only required if you don't use the source prop—if source is provided, children becomes optional.
explanations.53: This prop controls how fast each character appears when typewriter mode is on; if you leave it blank, the component automatically picks a speed based on how many lines are in the terminal.
explanations.54: This is the delay (in milliseconds) before output lines show up during typewriter animation; if omitted, it scales automatically depending on line count.
explanations.120: Inside JSX template literals (the backticks), dollar signs need a backslash in front of them to be treated as regular text instead of JavaScript variable placeholders.
